before:  mWakefulness=Awake
after KEYCODE_SLEEP:  mWakefulness=Dozing
  dumpsys display:    mState=DOZE_SUSPEND
  dumpsys wear_service:      watchFaceState=WatchFaceState{watchFaceVisible=true, inAmbient=true}
after KEYCODE_WAKEUP: mWakefulness=Awake
  dumpsys display:    mState=ON
  dumpsys wear_service:      watchFaceState=WatchFaceState{watchFaceVisible=true, inAmbient=false}
face not on screen (Settings in front): watchFaceState=WatchFaceState{watchFaceVisible=false, inAmbient=false}
